title: Regular meeting, October 20, 2026
location: District office, board room, 100 Commons Street
agenda: Call to order and pledge :: ||Public comment :: Four speakers||Superintendent's report :: First quarter attendance||Consent agenda :: Approved||Policy 4120, Student attendance :: Second reading and adoption||Policy 3550, Food allergies :: First reading||Adjourn :: 8:12 pm
votes: Consent agenda :: Approved 7–0||Policy 4120, Student attendance :: Adopted 6–1||Policy 3550, Food allergies :: Moved to second reading
summary: Adopted revised Policy 4120 (attendance) 6–1; first reading of Policy 3550 (food allergies).
body:
Draft minutes, not yet approved. Present: all seven members. Four members of the public spoke during public comment, three about bus stop times on Ostby Road and one about the attendance policy.

The board adopted revised Policy 4120 on a 6–1 vote. Member Halvorsen voted no, asking that the call-home threshold stay at three absences.
